C-FIX-013-NODE25-WEBSTORAGE-COMPAT.Name: Node 25+ Web Storage compatibility: keep jsdom localStorage authoritative in the vitest suite
C-FIX-013-NODE25-WEBSTORAGE-COMPAT.Summary: Node 25 enables experimental Web Storage by default and injects its own localStorage global into test workers; jsdom does not replace it, so every module that touches localStorage at import time fails with `TypeError: localStorage.getItem is not a function` (66 test files, 841 tests red on the Windows polygon, zero product defects). Guard the canonical vitest config with a conditional execArgv (`--no-experimental-webstorage` on Node >= 25 only — the Node 22 needs nothing and keeps byte-identical worker arguments), pin the reference runtime with .nvmrc, and add a functional localStorage regression check.
C-FIX-013-NODE25-WEBSTORAGE-COMPAT.ApprovalBasis: Owner review of the 2026-10-20 Windows polygon (the Windows test laptop) bring-up results. The owner confirmed the localStorage diagnosis as a known Node 25+/Vitest compatibility issue (Node.js v25.9.0 globals docs; vitest-dev/vitest#8757), noted CI is unaffected because .github/workflows/test.yml pins Node 22, and approved this exact scope as a small tooling-compatibility fix under M-046/V-M-046: (1) conditional test.execArgv for Node >= 25, (2) a regression check for functional localStorage getItem/setItem/clear, (3) .nvmrc/documented Node 22 as the reference environment, (4) the sidebar cold-start timeout stays a separate item — no global timeout raise.
C-FIX-013-NODE25-WEBSTORAGE-COMPAT.ProblemEvidence: Full `npm test` on the polygon (Windows 10 22H2, Node v25.8.1, main@bae95a9): `Test Files 66 failed | 272 passed`, `Tests 841 failed | 3800 passed`, with root-cause sample `TypeError: localStorage.getItem is not a function` at src/renderer/src/store/layout.js:5 and 331 worker warnings `--localstorage-file was provided without a valid path`. With `NODE_OPTIONS=--no-experimental-webstorage` the same tree runs 337/338 files green (the single remaining failure is the separate sidebar cold-start timeout). Node 22 (CI, .github/workflows/test.yml:63; local dev machines) has no default-on Web Storage and is unaffected. Nothing pins the local Node version, so any developer or future CI lane moving to Node >= 25 hits 841 red tests with no hint of the cause.

Goals.Goal: vitest.config.ts passes `--no-experimental-webstorage` to test workers only when the running Node major is >= 25, preserving inherited process.execArgv; Node 22 runs keep byte-identical execArgv behavior (flag omitted).

A regression test pins a functional jsdom localStorage contract (function-typed getItem/setItem/removeItem/clear/key plus a set/get/remove/clear/length roundtrip) so a re-emergence of a shadowed storage global fails with a pointed test name instead of 841 opaque import failures.
.nvmrc pins the Node 22 reference runtime that CI already uses (README "Requirements: Node.js 22" already documents it).

Constraints.Constraint: Do not pass the flag on Node < 25: the Node 22 reference runtime (flag accepted since 22.4.0, Web Storage not default-on) needs nothing, and unchanged worker arguments there are part of the contract — the guard parses the major version, never probing support.

No global testTimeout raise and no sidebar/index.test.js change: the polygon's remaining 5s first-import cold-start timeout is tracked separately (test-harness portability), and the owner explicitly scoped it out.
This is tooling compatibility only: no renderer/product code, no CI workflow edits (the Windows lane already pins Node 22).

NonGoals.NonGoal: No fix for the sideBar/index.test.js cold-start timeout — separate harness-portability item, owner-deferred.
No attempt to make Node 25 the reference runtime; Node 22 stays the reference.
No release action; delivery bookkeeping goes to the 2.6.x-next train as FIX-013.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: On Node >= 25 the canonical `npm test` needs no manual NODE_OPTIONS: workers start with `--no-experimental-webstorage`, no `--localstorage-file` warning is emitted, and the previously broken localStorage-dependent files pass.
On Node 22 the execArgv set for workers is byte-identical to today (flag absent, process.execArgv preserved) and the full suite stays green.
tests/renderer/localstorage-webstorage-compat.test.js fails on Node >= 25 without the execArgv guard and passes with it (proven on the polygon) and passes on Node 22 (proven locally).

AffectedAreas.Area: vitest.config.ts (conditional test.execArgv); tests/renderer/localstorage-webstorage-compat.test.js (new); .nvmrc (new); .grace/graph/features.xml M-046 summary line; .grace/verification/features.xml V-M-046 command + scenario-18; docs/release-trains/2.6.x-next.md FIX-013 entry.

VerificationIntent.Command: Windows polygon (Node 25): npm test with no NODE_OPTIONS — suite green apart from the separately tracked sidebar cold-start timeout
